targets.query:
from(bucket: "governanca-m365")
  |> range(start: -1d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m365_users" and r._field == "total")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "governanca-m365")
  |> range(start: -1d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m365_mfa" and r._field == "habilitados")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "governanca-m365")
  |> range(start: -1d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m365_mfa" and r._field == "desabilitados")
  |> last()

hab = from(bucket: "governanca-m365") |> range(start: -1d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m365_mfa" and r._field == "habilitados") |> last() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
des = from(bucket: "governanca-m365") |> range(start: -1d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m365_mfa" and r._field == "desabilitados") |> last() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
from(bucket: "governanca-m365")
  |> range(start: -1d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m365_mfa" and r._field == "habilitados")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) / (float(v: hab._value) + float(v: des._value)) * 100.0}))

from(bucket: "governanca-m365")
  |> range(start: -1d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m365_incidents" and r._field == "total_ativos")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "governanca-m365")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m365_service_status" and r._field == "status_code")
  |> last()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 1)
  |> count()

from(bucket: "governanca-m365")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m365_users" and r._field == "total")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "governanca-m365")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m365_mfa")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "governanca-m365")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m365_service_status" and r._field == "status_text")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["service","_value","_time"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Status", service: "Serviço", _time: "Última verificação"})

from(bucket: "governanca-m365")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m365_incident_detail")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["id","service"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["id","service","classification","status"])
  |> rename(columns: {id: "ID", service: "Serviço", classification: "Classificação", status: "Status"})

from(bucket: "governanca-m365")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m365_incident_detail" and r._field == "status")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["service"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "governanca-m365")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "m365_incident_detail" and r._field == "classification")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["_value"])
  |> count()
